Message Formats:
  F0 42 3g 68 43 <type> <comp> <sub> <param id> <index> <value> F7

  <type>
        09: HD-1 patch 1
        0A: HD-1 patch 2
        0B: EXi patch 1
        0C: EXi patch 2
  <comp>, <sub>
        single-byte values from table
  <param id>
        pp: (7-bit) for parameter ids in the range of 0..126
        7F pp pp: (14-bit, MSB first) for parameter ids in the range of 127..16383 (deprecated)
  <index>
        single-byte value from table
  <value>
        vv vv vv: 21-bit signed value, MSB first


  F0 42 3g 68 44 <type> <comp> <sub> <param id> <index> <value type> <value> F7

  <type>, <comp>, <sub>
        (as above)
  <param id>
        pp: parameter id
  <index>
        (as above)
  <value type>
        02: 16-byte UUID
  <value>
        binary value converted to 7-bit sys/ex data (see *3 in KRONOS_MIDI_SysEx.txt)
